title: On Reeb spaces of non-proper smooth functions which are $1$-dimensional CW complexes
summary: We discuss Reeb spaces of non-proper smooth functions. (Non-)proper functions are maps between topological spaces the preimages of compact sets by which are compact (resp. may not be compact). Their Reeb spaces are the spaces of connected components of their level sets and with the natural quotient topologies. In proper cases, explicit theory are developing since the 1950s. This is closely related to Morse(-Bott) function theory and in such cases we have graphs naturally.
